newsitem.title: USA: Swing-N-Slide says April sales were strong.
newsitem.headline: Swing-N-Slide says April sales were strong.

text.p: Swing-N-Slide Corp, which earlier reported a loss for the first quarter, said Wednesday orders and sales at its core consumer playground equipment and its GameTime unit were strong in April.
The company said orders and sales at both Swing-N-Slide and GameTime were higher last month than during April of 1996.

"While core product sales during the first quarter were slightly below 1996 levels, strong orders and sales results for both the Swing-N-Slide and GameTime divisions during April put us back on plan with sales at both divisions ahead of 1996 on a year-to-date basis," said President and Chief Executive Richard Mueller.

Earlier, the company reported a loss of $1.1 million, or $0.18 a share, including an after-tax charge of $860,000 or $0.14 a share, for the write-off of financing fees associated with the company's previous credit agreement.
In the first quarter of 1996, Swing-N-Slide lost $1.2 million, or $0.19 a share.

Sales rose to $10.8 million in the first quarter from $9.6 million a year earlier. This year's results included about $2.0 million from the company's GameTime division, representing sales since the completion of its acquisition.
